limits: Synthetic owned branching WinForms fixture, not unconstrained tasks in arbitrary applications.
Client gaps include active-agent deliberation, tool rendering, CLI startup and transport; they are not isolated model inference. Native/server time is measured separately.
Atomic vs fused is a controlled orchestration comparison using existing batch capability; it does not prove shorter instructions make a model faster.
Two unknown-until-observed instructions per trial, three action kinds. Final fixture state independently verifies completion and wrong actions.
In-memory MCP transport isolates server/native work; loopback HTTP and CLI bridge are additional benchmark overhead, not production stdio latency.
Test key and no overlay isolate execution and journal overhead; no real user data or satisfaction labels.
